agree.reason: A quick reader comes away with a clear, believable picture of a reliable worker who already uses herd data, which should make them want to admit him, though nothing sets him clearly above the other 149 applicants.

honest.reason: Most claims stay with the brief, but 'catches problems with it that others miss' and 'the cows are milked properly' are not in the facts; the letter also leaves out that he gave only two days' notice before leaving for five weeks.

works_the_facts.reason: The facts are restated rather than worked: the letter never turns 'two missed shifts in three years' into its stronger form (about 2 of roughly 780 solo early-morning shifts) and never puts the nine mastitis cases in proportion to the herd.

right_comparison.reason: There is no real alternative to compare against, though the line 'nobody is there to check on him' does contrast his solo shift with supervised work.

qualification.reason: The hedge on his written English names something the reader can check (a night class) but gives no timeline, level or expected result, so the reader cannot judge when or whether it will be resolved.

objections.reason: It deals with the two likely concerns, written English and the five-week absence, by naming each one and giving context, without raising worries the facts already answer.

fit.reason: It is a one-page reference letter from the farm manager with suitable placeholders and a sign-off, as the brief asked.
